currentGateBStatus.description: Audit findings C1, C1-01 and C1-02. The single recorded fact set for CURRENT Gate-B and proposal status. phase5_plan_consistency.py DERIVES a status tuple from each region below by parsing the revision claims in its prose - including the detached 'proposal revision number (currently N)' form that audit finding C1-01 showed slipping past the earlier regex - then compares every region against this block and against the other regions. Each region declares the FACTS it must speak to, not the conclusions it must state: the validator reads each fact's current value out of 'facts' and looks up the assertion that value requires in 'factAssertions', so flipping a fact changes what every region is required to say. Audit finding C1-02: regions previously named assertion labels directly, so the booleans under 'facts' were never compared with anything and setting independentReviewRequiredAndAuthorized to false exited 0 while six regions went on asserting the opposite. It does not rely on an exact stale-phrase list, and no 'Corrected at revision' marker exempts a region: a labelled historical note is excluded by SLICING the region, never by matching a marker near a hit.

derivationRules: Within each region, every 'proposal revision(s) N' mention is classified from a bounded local window (up to the next such mention, capped) as FAILED / UNREVIEWED / SUPERSEDED / CURRENT.

The detached form 'proposal revision number (currently N)' is ALSO parsed, as a CURRENT claim. Audit finding C1-01: the earlier regex required a digit immediately after 'proposal revision', so a numbering note saying 'currently 5' contradicted a header saying 6 and still exited 0.
failed(region) must be a subset of failedProposalRevisions.
unreviewed(region) must not intersect failedProposalRevisions - a failed revision has been reviewed, so calling it unreviewed is the C1 defect class.
current(region) must be a subset of {proposalRevision}.
superseded(region) must be a subset of failedProposalRevisions + supersededUnreviewedProposalRevisions.
No region may mention a proposal revision greater than proposalRevision.
Every region that classifies any revision must place proposalRevision in unreviewed or current.

Each region's mustAssertFacts names FACTS, not conclusions. The required assertion is looked up as factAssertions[fact][value-of-fact-in-facts], so the booleans under 'facts' are what the prose is compared against. Audit finding C1-02: regions previously named assertion labels directly, so no fact was ever read and a true->false mutation of independentReviewRequiredAndAuthorized exited 0.
A fact whose current value has no entry in factAssertions fails; an unmapped state is never treated as satisfied.

The validator's own success line is rendered FROM the facts, never from a fixed string. Audit finding C1-02: the passing diagnostic hard-coded 'no review or approval request authorized' and reported the withdrawn state on every clean run.
Regions are compared with one another, not only with the ledger, so a matched pair of wrong regions is still caught by the ledger comparison and a single drifted region by both.

factAssertions.description: Audit finding C1-02. Maps each recorded fact to the assertion every region carrying that fact must make, keyed by the fact's CURRENT value. This is what makes the status derivation real: the expected wording is looked up from the boolean, so a ledger-only mutation of a fact re-points every region at the opposite assertion and fails. A fact value with no entry here is itself a failure - an undefined state must never be silently unchecked.

auditFreshness.description: Added at plan revision 3.7. A new independent audit landing against the CURRENT candidate must not be able to coexist with continuity documents that still call that candidate unreviewed - which is exactly the state this repository was in when PLAN_3_6_STRUCTURAL_AUDIT.md existed on disk while the handoff, the plan and the proposal all still said plan 3.6 / proposal 7 were unreviewed and awaiting a fresh review. phase5_plan_consistency.py reads the audited plan and proposal revisions out of each audit report's own title line - not out of this block - so an unrecorded report cannot hide.
rules: Every audit report on disk must be recorded below, at its exact SHA-256, and must parse.

No audit may target the current planRevision/proposalRevision while facts.currentProposalReviewed is false: an audit of the current candidate means the candidate HAS been reviewed, and every 'unreviewed' region, including the handoff, is then stale by construction.
An audit with a STRUCTURAL FAIL verdict requires its audited proposal revision to appear in currentGateBStatus.failedProposalRevisions.
The handoff must pin the latest audit's full SHA-256, so a newer audit cannot land without the handoff being rewritten.
